hikes.name: Toketee Falls
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a two-tier falls pouring through a frame of dark columnar basalt.

hikes.name: Watson Falls
hikes.blurb: Up to a bridge in front of southern Oregon's tallest falls, 293 feet off a mossy cliff.

hikes.name: Susan Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy walk under maples to a falls in a fern-covered bowl, and Indian mounds above.

hikes.name: Wolf Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Along Wolf Creek's mossy canyon to a slender, two-part falls.

hikes.name: Hershberger Lookout
hikes.blurb: From Acker Divide Trailhead, an 11.2-mile round trip to Hershberger Lookout, with about 2,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Alkali Falls
hikes.blurb: From Lewis Sno-Park, a 13.5-mile round trip to Alkali Falls, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Falls
hikes.blurb: From Fish Lake Trailhead, a 5.9-mile round trip to Falls, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wolf Lake
hikes.blurb: From Happy Camp Trailhead, a 13.1-mile round trip to Wolf Lake, with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Fish Lake
hikes.blurb: From Skimmerhorn Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to Fish Lake, with about 1,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Snow Lakes
hikes.blurb: From Acker Divide Trailhead, a 6.4-mile round trip to Snow Lakes, with about 1,200 feet of climbing.
